EEGReference: Ipsilateral earlobe: A1 for left-hemisphere and A2 for right-hemisphere sites
EEGPlacementScheme: International 10-20 system, 16 scalp sites, no midline electrodes
TaskDescription: Three Balinese dance movements (ngeed, agem right, agem left), 4 repetitions each in two blocks separated by a 3-min standing rest (descent, hold, ascent paced by an instruction display), followed by a Romberg-type protocol: 30 s standing with eyes open, 15 s rest, 30 s with eyes closed.
